units.text: Apple Q3 2025 Form 10-Q reports Japan net sales of $22.067 billion for the nine months ended June 28, 2025, and $5.782 billion for the three-month quarter ending June 28, 2025.

judgement.reason: The cited Form 10-Q table lists Japan net sales as $5,782 million for the three months and $22,067 million for the nine months ended June 28, 2025, which equal $5.782 billion and $22.067 billion.

units.text: Bullfincher source reports Apple Japan Segment generated $28.70 B in revenue for fiscal 2025, rounded to two decimal places, not $28.703 billion.
